title: Uniform Validity of Resampling-Based Equivalence Screening Tests under Decaying Margins
banked_reason: Frozen frontier requires an unavailable validated outward multidimensional Gaussian integration certificate; theorem not refuted.
gap_reasons: Required frontier certification cannot run: no Sage executable or Sage Python module is installed, and discovery/certificates/finite_frontier_1000 is absent. Per the active directive, halted without a partial proof bundle.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery corrected the published Algorithm 1 finite-bank law and attested two Yang–Liu–Evans citations. The full radius/level frontier still requires a validated outward Gaussian integral certificate; repeated workers could not produce one because Sage/Arb support is unavailable. The theorem was not refuted, and the numerical claims remain exploratory pending a reproducible numerics stage.
tldr: The actual finite-replicate Algorithm 1 admits an explicit selected Gaussian law in the three-category causal experiment. At \(J=K=1000\), \(R=6\), and nominal causal level \(0.05\), its null rejection limit exceeds \(0.0682\); because each row is inside the Yang--Liu--Evans source class, this is a counterexample to a uniform \(0.05\)-level extension over the decaying-margin regime explicitly left open in Remark 3.19. An outward rank-35/rank-36 separation proves that the baseline-adaptive rule selects exactly rank \(35\) at the uniform baseline and throughout an open neighborhood, where its reference power remains strictly above current-only testing. A fixed-law, fixed-radius construction separately shows that the common-seed fusion indicator is nonconstant across the balanced orbit with probability tending to one, invalidating the measurability step in Theorem A.4 without claiming that Corollary 3.17 itself is false.
gap: YangLiuEvans2026, Corollary 3.17, is the asymptotic-level result under fixed-law hypotheses; Corollary 3.18 is consistency, and Remark 3.19 concerns lack of full consistency under fixed-law alternatives. Those hypotheses do not cover the present shrinking-margin triangular array. The source's later population-quantile discussion also does not characterize the actual fixed finite E-MMD-Boot and partial-permutation banks. Appendix A.2.2, Theorem A.4, treats fusion selection as measurable under an unlabeled current-label field, although the common-seed screen can change across that orbit.
fill: The project first proves the sampling bridge from potential-outcome marginals to the independent observed arm laws and identifies their contrast as the causal distributional estimand. It then proves the fixed-\((J,K)\) joint selected law, diagnoses source-specific orbit measurability with algorithmic seeds included, makes finite-rank calibration total by an explicit abstention branch, proves uniform nonemptiness at the declared budget, certifies a genuine positive-rank actual-budget inflation and strict-power witness, and derives the oracle and diagonal limits as corollaries.
